name: Classic
summary: The fixed smoothing mode, based on XIM's older XIM APEX device. Tuned with Smooth, Decay and Synch.

where.text: Edit your Config (pencil icon). In Mouse Aim or Motion Aim, set Smoothing to Custom instead of a preset, then press the smoothing button to switch between STANDARD and CLASSIC.

citations.quote: To edit the current Config, press the pencil icon.
Here you can set Sensitivity (remember that lower values are faster) and Smoothing.
Motion aim settings consists of Sensitivity and Smoothing.
You can also customize the smoothing system and choose between two smoothing modes: Standard and Classic.
It's recommended you use one of the smoothing presets. If you are using "custom", ensure you do not reduce smoothing intensity below that of the presets.
Press the the smoothing button (i.e. "STANDARD" or "CLASSIC") to change modes.

definition.text: The Classic system is based on our past generation XIM APEX device which provides static smoothing behavior. It has been upgraded to provide additional customization and flexibility.

citations.quote: The Classic system is based on our past generation XIM APEX device which provides static smoothing behavior. It has been upgraded to provide additional customization and flexibility.

definition.caveat: Primer covers XIM MATRIX only and gives no Destiny 2 values for Classic. The only Classic values the guide gives are for matching XIM APEX behavior (below).

plainWords.text: Classic applies the same smoothing whatever your aim speed. Standard, by contrast, adapts to it.

citations.quote: The Classic system is based on our past generation XIM APEX device which provides static smoothing behavior. It has been upgraded to provide additional customization and flexibility.
The Standard system provides dynamic smoothing behavior that adapts to your current aim speed.

plainWords.reasoning: The guide calls Classic "static" and Standard "dynamic" smoothing that "adapts to your current aim speed". We read static as not adapting to speed.

plainWords.text: It has three settings: Smooth (how strong the smoothing is), Decay (how much past input counts) and Synch (extra smoothing that combines with Smooth).

citations.quote: Higher values increase impact and is further customized using the Decay setting.
Controls how much the Smooth setting relies on past inputs. Higher values decrease the impact of older input values.
Higher values increase impact and can be combined with Smooth to further amplify the smoothing effect.

plainWords.text: For behavior equivalent to the older XIM APEX, the guide says Smooth values match XIM APEX behavior, Decay should be set to 9.0, and Synch should use 8=Default, 16=Common, 32=Slow, or 0=Off.

citations.quote: For equivalent XIM APEX behavior, set to 9.0
For equivalent XIM APEX values, use: 8=Default, 16=Common, 32=Slow, or 0=Off

plainWords.caveat: Default, Common, Slow and Off are the XIM APEX values being matched. The guide doesn't give the MATRIX default for Synch. These values are for matching XIM APEX behavior, not Destiny 2 recommendations.

guidance.text: Try the presets first. XIM says smoothing is strictly preference.

citations.quote: Both mouse and motion have different presets designed for those aiming methods. Start by trying each out to see what feels most natural to you. It's strictly based on preference.

aimStyles.text: Classic can't favour one aim style: it smooths slow tracking and fast snaps the same way. Primer's aim-style directions for smoothing assume Standard. With Classic you get the definitions, not the directions.

citations.quote: The Classic system is based on our past generation XIM APEX device which provides static smoothing behavior. It has been upgraded to provide additional customization and flexibility.
The Standard system provides dynamic smoothing behavior that adapts to your current aim speed.

aimStyles.reasoning: Classic provides "static smoothing behavior", unlike Standard's smoothing that "adapts to your current aim speed".

statement.text: Classic is based on the smoothing of XIM's previous device, the XIM APEX, upgraded for the MATRIX.

citations.quote: The Classic system is based on our past generation XIM APEX device which provides static smoothing behavior. It has been upgraded to provide additional customization and flexibility.

statement.caveat: Primer covers XIM MATRIX only and gives no advice written for the XIM APEX itself. The MATRIX guide's settings for matching XIM APEX behavior are listed under Classic.
